source_refs.note: Exercise 14.2, Question 3 (i)-(ii): alpha for perpendicular vectors (book p.274). In (i) the print of v = i - 2j + alpha k is smudged ('+ alpha' overlaps). Answers agree with the key.

blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Find a real number \(\alpha\) so that the vectors \(\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{v}\) are perpendicular: \(\underline{u} = \alpha\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \alpha\underline{k}\)
blocks.explanation:
Do vectors perpendicular (90 degree par) hon to un ka dot product zero hota hai, kyunke \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\).
Diya kya hai? Dono vectors, jin mein ek unknown \(\alpha\) hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(\alpha\) ki woh value jis par vectors perpendicular hon.
Plan: dot product \(\alpha\) mein likhein, zero ke barabar rakhein, equation solve karein, aur jawab wapas rakh kar check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{u} = \alpha\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \alpha\underline{k}\), aur dono perpendicular hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(\alpha\).
Tareeqa: Do non-zero vectors tabhi perpendicular hote hain jab \(\underline{u}\cdot\underline{v} = 0\) ho. Dot product nikalne se \(\alpha\) wali ek equation banegi, jise solve kar ke \(\alpha\) mil jayega.

Dot product \(\alpha\) mein likhein
\[\underline{u}\cdot\underline{v} = (\alpha)(1) + (3)(-2) + (1)(\alpha)\]
\[= \alpha - 6 + \alpha = 2\alpha - 6\]
Kyun: Matching components multiply kar ke jama kiye. \(\alpha\) ko bilkul ek aam number ki tarah treat kiya. \(\underline{i}\) wala \(\alpha \times 1\), \(\underline{j}\) wala \(3 \times (-2) = -6\), aur \(\underline{k}\) wala \(1 \times \alpha\). Do \(\alpha\) jama hue to \(2\alpha\).

Zero ke barabar rakh kar solve karein
\[2\alpha - 6 = 0\]
\[\alpha = 3\]
Kyun: Perpendicular ka matlab angle 90 degree, aur \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\), is liye \(|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\cos\theta\) bhi zero. Equation linear hai (\(\alpha\) ki power 1), is liye sirf ek jawab aata hai: 6 ko doosri taraf le gaye aur 2 se divide kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[\underline{u} = 3\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k},\ \underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\]
\[\underline{u}\cdot\underline{v} = 3 - 6 + 3 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\alpha = 3\) dono vectors mein rakh kar dot product dobara nikala; zero aaya, yani vectors waqai perpendicular hain.
Dhyan dein: \(\alpha\) dono vectors mein hai; check karte waqt dono jagah value rakhiye.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Find a real number \(\alpha\) so that the vectors \(\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{v}\) are perpendicular: \(\underline{u} = \alpha\underline{i} + 2\alpha\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + \alpha\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\)
blocks.explanation:
Do vectors perpendicular (90 degree par) hon to un ka dot product zero hota hai, kyunke \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\).
Diya kya hai? Dono vectors, jin mein ek unknown \(\alpha\) hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(\alpha\) ki woh value jis par vectors perpendicular hon.
Plan: dot product \(\alpha\) mein likhein, zero ke barabar rakhein, equation solve karein, aur jawab wapas rakh kar check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{u} = \alpha\underline{i} + 2\alpha\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + \alpha\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), aur dono perpendicular hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(\alpha\).
Tareeqa: Wohi shart \(\underline{u}\cdot\underline{v} = 0\). Lekin is dafa \(\alpha\) dono vectors ke \(\underline{j}\) component mein hai, is liye multiply karne par \(\alpha^2\) banega aur quadratic equation aayegi, jis ke do jawab ho sakte hain.

Dot product \(\alpha\) mein likhein
\[\underline{u}\cdot\underline{v} = (\alpha)(1) + (2\alpha)(\alpha) + (-1)(3)\]
\[= 2\alpha^2 + \alpha - 3\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\) wale: \(\alpha \times 1 = \alpha\); \(\underline{j}\) wale: \(2\alpha \times \alpha = 2\alpha^2\); \(\underline{k}\) wale: \((-1)(3) = -3\). Phir powers ke hisaab se tarteeb di.

Zero rakh kar factorise karein
\[2\alpha^2 + \alpha - 3 = 0\]
\[2\alpha^2 + 3\alpha - 2\alpha - 3 = 0\]
\[\alpha(2\alpha + 3) - 1(2\alpha + 3) = 0\]
\[(\alpha - 1)(2\alpha + 3) = 0\]
Kyun: Middle term todne ka tareeqa: pehle aur aakhri coefficient ka product \(2 \times (-3) = -6\). Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product \(-6\) aur jama 1 ho: woh 3 aur \(-2\) hain. Phir do do terms ka common nikala.

Dono values nikalein
\[\alpha = 1 \quad \text{ya} \quad \alpha = -\dfrac{3}{2}\]
Kyun: Do cheezon ka product zero tabhi hota hai jab un mein se koi ek zero ho. \(\alpha - 1 = 0\) se \(\alpha = 1\), aur \(2\alpha + 3 = 0\) se \(\alpha = -\frac{3}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: Quadratic ke dono jawab likhiye; sirf ek likhna adhoora jawab hai.

Tasdeeq: dono values check karein
\[\alpha = 1:\ 2 + 1 - 3 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[\alpha = -\tfrac{3}{2}:\ \tfrac{9}{2} - \tfrac{3}{2} - 3 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(2\alpha^2 + \alpha - 3\) mein dono values rakhin: \(\alpha = -\frac{3}{2}\) par \(2 \times \frac{9}{4} = \frac{9}{2}\). Dono dafa zero aaya, is liye dono values par vectors perpendicular hain.
